description: What Medicaid paid per prescription (CMS State Drug Utilization Data, newest four quarters) and what Medicare drug plans paid per claim (CMS Part D Prescribers by Geography and Drug, newest year) for a menopause treatment, nationally or in one US state, with each drug's Medicare spending per unit over five years. What a payer paid, not a price a person pays. Accepts a treatment, e.g. "estradiol patch", and an optional two-letter state code, e.g. "TX".

state.description: Two-letter US state code; national when left out

name: menopause_public_payers
title: What Medicaid and Medicare paid
